title: Support moment at the centreline, at the face, and with the EN reduction

rubric.text: The response should find the face moment from the centreline moment, the shear at the support and the load over the half-width, and use dM = FEd,sup x t/8 with the full support reaction for the EN case.

expert_notes: MB = wL^2/8 = 415.3; VB = 0.625wL = 230.7 kN each side. Face: 415.3 - 230.7 x 0.25 + 41.02 x 0.25^2/2 = 358.9 (ACI 318-19 9.4.2.1). EN 5.3.2.2(4): F = 461.5 kN, dM = 461.5 x 0.5/8 = 28.8, M = 386.5. Using V x c/2 without the load term gives 357.6 (inside the tolerance); using half the reaction in the EN formula gives 400.9.
